දිවයිනේ න ොන ෝ ප්‍රනේශවල ප්‍රධොන වශනෙේ වැසි රහිත කොලගුණ තත්තත්තවෙක් පවතී.

GENERAL WEATHER FORECAST FOR NEXT 36 HOURS
Issued at 04.00 p.m. on 26 February 2026
Mainly fair weather will prevail over the most parts of the island.
Showers or thundershowers are likely at a few places in Southern province and in Rathnapura and
Monaragala districts after 2.00 p.m.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central, Sabaragamuwa, Western, North-
western and North-central provinces and in Galle, Matara, Monaragala and Mannar districts during
the early hours of the morning.
